to: player chat: every socket on this server, observers too (`broadcast`). An NPC or monster line: each character and observer that can see the speaker (`xy_emit`)

variants.name: Player chat
variants.when: A character sent `say` without `name` and without `party`, or a player used the public chat of the web Communicator.

variants.name: NPC or monster line
variants.when: A localized line: Ace in the arena (a kill), the Grinch, or the mainframe alert in cyberland.

variants.name: Mainframe reply
variants.when: The reply of the mainframe to an `eval` with `command`, in cyberland. `message` is plain text; there is no `phrase`.

ChatLogPlayer.summary: A public chat line of a player.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The text, at most 1,200 characters. The server removes some characters first (`strip_string`).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The id of the speaker: the character name. From the web Communicator it is `"comm:"` plus the database id of the character (api.js:1195).

ChatLogNpc.summary: A chat line of an NPC or a monster. Most lines have a phrase key for translation.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: The name that the client shows: `"Ace"` (the `pvp` NPC), `"Grinch"` or `"mainframe"`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: `"pvp"`, `"mainframe"`, or the monster id of the Grinch.

fields.name: phrase
fields.description: The phrase key, for example `server.chat_log.pwned`. Absent on a mainframe reply.

fields.name: phrase_args
fields.description: The values for the phrase. Absent on a mainframe reply.

senders.what: `deliver_chat_message` without a recipient: the `say` handler, or the web Communicator (`communicator_say`, which runs on the game server through `server_eval`).
A kill in the arena: Ace announces it (`server.chat_log.pwned`).
A defeat in the arena: Ace announces it (`server.chat_log.defeated`).
The Grinch talks (one of the `server.grinch.*` phrases).
The cyberland loop, every 10 s or more: a monster in cyberland has a target (`server.chat_log.alert`).
The `eval` handler with `command`: the mainframe reply.
